brief:
Israel's three largest airlines announced plans to resume service to Dubai following what Israeli officials characterized as an attempted attack on a flydubai aircraft bound for Tel Aviv on Wednesday, Al-Monitor reported. The incident prompted temporary suspension of flights between the two cities.

Details of the alleged attack and the timeline for resuming service were not disclosed in the announcement.
dek: By Steven Scheer JERUSALEM, Oct 1 (Reuters) - Israel's three largest airlines said on Thursday they planned to resume flights to Dubai after what Israeli officials have said was an apparent attempt to crash a flydubai flight to Tel Aviv the previous day.
title: Israeli airlines plan to resume Dubai flights after flydubai incident
